newsitem.title: SWEDEN: S&P assigns rating to Lansforsakringsbolagens.
newsitem.headline: S&P assigns rating to Lansforsakringsbolagens.

text.p: U.S. credit rating agency Standard & Poor's said on Wednesday it had assigned a single A claims paying ability rating to Lansforsakringsbolagens AB, a member of the LF insurance group.
Lansforsakringsbolagens (LFAB) is owned by 24 regional mutual insurers with their roots in the Swedish agricultural community.

S&P said positive rating factors included LFAB's core status in the group, LF's superior risk-based quality adequacy, strong domestic business position, successful distribution network and satisfactory earnings outlook.
But the agency said in a statement that these strengths were to a degree offset by a number of factors.

These included intensifying competition in the rapidly changing Swedish finance sector, LF's relatively cumbersome decision making processes, its modest share of the growing life assurance and savings market and its somewhat restricted financial flexibility.
